d: any kind of net, but in the NT referring only to nets used for catching fish
a circular net with weights and a draw rope around its edge; used in fishing

small, curved piece of metal or bone or even a strong thorn, with a sharp point on one end, usually with a barb just behind the point, and a loop or bend on the other end to which a fishing line can be attached; used with some bait attached to it in order to attract a fish
a long seine net used in fishing
